message.content: {"claims":[{"quote":"The service must meet the Maritime Passenger Records Act, section 12."},{"quote":"Passenger names must be retained for seven years under the operator's licence condition 7.3."},{"quote":"Once live, a seat picker will cut support calls by 52%."},{"quote":"Once live, a live-map screen will cut support calls by 47%."},{"quote":"Once live, a seat picker will cut support calls by 64%."}],"needs":[{"quote":"Tickets should feel instant."}],"stories":[{"quote":"As a day visitors traveller, I want to buy a return ticket for Northgate to Saltmarsh so that I can plan one trip."},{"quote":"As an operator, I want to export sailings so that finance can reconcile them."},{"quote":"As a ticket inspector, I want to scan a code so that I can confirm a booking quickly."},{"quote":"As a freight clerks traveller, I want to buy a return ticket for Northgate to Saltmarsh so that I can plan one trip."},{"quote":"As a commuters traveller, I want to be told of a delay so that I can rebook."},{"quote":"As a ticket inspector, I want to scan a code so that I can confirm a booking quickly."}],"dependencies":[{"quote":"We rely on the harbour CCTV vendor for berth availability."},{"quote":"Sam Okoro on the payments gateway team will confirm the schedule feed by June."},{"quote":"Delivery depends on the payments gateway team, with no named owner yet."}]}
